test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Cultural performances ‘MILAN 2022’ was organised by the Ministry of Culture as a part of Azadi ka Amrit Mahostav in which City?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Visakhapatnam**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Ministry of Culture** sponsors cultural acts as a part of the Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav in **Visakhapatnam** for "MILAN 2022."
 
• The Ministry of Culture will take part in "**MILAN 2022**," which was held from February 26–28, 2022, at Ramakrishna Beach and Milan Village in Visakhapatnam, and organised by the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA) in partnership with the Eastern Naval Command and the Government of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Every two years, a global naval exercise called **MILAN** is held.
 
• "**Camaraderie, Cohesion, Collaboration**" was the theme of MILAN 2022, and it truly embodies the exercise's spirit.
 
• For MILAN 2022, **46 **friendly nations had been invited.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The program's prominence was also enhanced by the presence of approximately **140 high-level foreign delegates**, **14 foreign warships and planes**, and** Indian Navy troops**.
 
• The officials from these nations will also see** kites** and **Rangolis** during the event.
 
• Through the online platform of** AKAM**, residents of Vishakhapatnam and others around the world can take in all of the cultural programmes.
